title: Praktor Workflow Specification
description: A schema for defining Praktor DSL (v9.0) workflow files.

variables.description: Global variables available for Mustache templating and expression evaluation.

env.description: Global environment variables available to all tasks.

dotEnv.description: Paths to .env files to load into the global environment.

defaults.description: Default attributes applied to all tasks.

includes.description: Named workflow files whose tasks and default values are included.

tasks.description: The list of all task definitions in the workflow.

stringMap.description: A mapping of keys to values. Values support Mustache templating and variable interpolation.

triggerActionList.description: A list of task names to execute when a trigger event fires.

items.description: Name of a task to execute as a trigger action.

triggersBlock.description: Defines event-driven actions to take upon task completion.

on_success.description: Tasks to execute when the task completes successfully.

on_failure.description: Tasks to execute when the task fails (after all retries).

on_complete.description: Tasks to execute regardless of success or failure.

sources.description: Input files or globs used for incremental freshness checks.

generates.description: Output files produced by the task.

finally.description: Task invoked through the on_complete trigger lifecycle.

program.description: Executable path or program name for raw process execution. Does not invoke a shell.

download.description: Streams one absolute HTTPS URL to a local file, with optional SHA-256 verification and atomic replacement.

args.description: Argument vector passed to program without shell parsing.

script.description: Post-processing script executed after the task action completes. Uses the built-in scripting language with access to ctx, json, dll, http, and log modules.

dynamic_tasks.description: Generate and execute tasks dynamically at runtime.

items_variable.description: Context path to a JSON array that drives task generation.

actions.description: Explicit orchestration tree used as the task runner.

value.description: Sibling value for flat set_variable syntax

from.description: Sibling source key for flat set_variable syntax

oneOf.description: Simple syntax: shell command as a string
Map syntax: shell command with parameters

output_key.description: Task output key for extracted data
Task output key for extracted data

filter.description: Optional regex filter for matching lines

Map syntax: file check with parameters

fail_if_missing.description: Fail the node if file doesn't exist (default: true)

Simple syntax: sleep duration as string (e.g., '5s', '100ms')

duration.description: Sleep duration (number in ms or string like '5s')

reason.description: Optional reason for the delay (for logging)
